dialogues.speaker: Venier
dialogues.text: Capitolium? Why, it's... it's... Wait. Where is it again?

dialogues.speaker: Venier
dialogues.text: Strange. Why did that word suddenly leave my lips? It's as if it was my hometown, where my family is.

dialogues.speaker: Venier
dialogues.text: *sigh* Alas, but I no longer have any family.

dialogues.speaker: Venier
dialogues.text: If this Capitolium is some dream world or the afterlife, may I reunite with them there!
